lastChange.note: 2.14: GAP-165 resolved in five parts plus GAP-157, GAP-158, GAP-159, GAP-163 and GAP-164. A deel-link mints an anonymous read-only session: new shell variant .pp-app.guest (head bar, two destinations, Sessie afsluiten; no avatar, theme, Uitloggen or live dot), new components ScreenShareSession and AanvraagDialog, the reduced Deze print card for role User, a request ends in its own picker or is deleted, and the spool trigger gives back its 32px at 360px. New classes .pp-app.guest, .pp-guesthead, .pp-guestnav, .pp-fname.sans, .pp-spoolbtn > .nm. 28 new copy keys, none changed or removed. No token added, renamed or removed; no new colour pair.
